article.title: Deduction in case of new industrial undertakings employing displaced persons, etc.
article.html:
80HDeduction in case of new industrial undertakings employing displaced persons, etc.

[Omitted by the Taxation Laws (Amendment) Act, 1975, w.e.f. 1-4-1976. Originally, it was inserted by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 1967, w.e.f. 1-4-1968.]
